identificationModule.briefTitle: Rituximab in Treating Patients With Low Tumor Burden Indolent Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Randomized Phase III Trial Comparing Two Different Rituximab Dosing Regimens For Patients With Low Tumor Burden Indolent Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma

armGroups.label: Arm A: Rituximab Retreatment
armGroups.description: Patients receive rituximab IV once a week for 4 weeks upon disease progression provided time to progression is more than 6 months.

armGroups.label: Arm B: Rituximab Scheduled
armGroups.description: Patients receive a single dose of rituximab IV once every 13 weeks until disease progression and in the absence of unacceptable toxicity.
